outcome.implementation_scope: Optional bounded projection of immutable Doctor classified gaps into environmental-capability session activity.
outcome.implementation_change: Added --doctor-gap-limit to the existing ECI projection. The default performs no Doctor evidence fetch. A nonzero limit loads the exact immutable Doctor record through the strict Store reader, verifies content-derived identity and binding to the session epoch, groups classified gaps by code, caps capability examples and groups, and preserves source snapshot and bounded same-session digest history. Sensitive free-form diagnostic reasons and workspace paths are not copied into the projection.
outcome.verified_change: All 160 capability-intelligence tests passed in the combined run; the four focused Doctor/history/CLI tests passed again; the Environment vertical proof and CLI lint passed. The post-commit ECI readback verified the Doctor source record and exposed 18 classified gaps in one bounded group with eight examples and ten omitted. It preserved the earlier-snapshot revision and did not claim cross-session recurrence.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The projection makes verified Doctor classifications discoverable through the existing ECI interface. No independent later agent activity establishes that it reduced intervention or improved downstream service quality. A separate ambient projection provider-binding pressure remains unresolved.

improvement_relation.basis: The strict source-record identity check, epoch binding, bounded grouping, default no-read behavior, mismatch fail-closed behavior, and compaction limits are covered by focused tests. The live ECI projection uses the same authenticated session source, reports verified content identity, and preserves measurement uncertainty.
not_measured: cross-session recurrence or generality across other Doctor classifications
agent discovery, receipt, or usability across different models and runtimes
time or tool calls saved by avoiding a separate Doctor evidence query
whether the diagnostic group identifies a real provider contract defect
resolution of the separate mncs-doctor:projection-health ambient binding deferral
long-term service quality or intervention-burden reduction

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign

measurement_limits: The live readback is from the implementing campaign session and is not independent evidence of downstream effectiveness.
The combined Environment test suite was interrupted before completion; the capability-intelligence module and targeted regression tests passed.
The distinct projection-provider deferral remains unresolved and is recorded as a next investigation, not as a defect proven by this implementation.
